newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ci Technologies in contract deal with WMC.
newsitem.headline: Ci Technologies in contract deal with WMC.

text.p: CI Technologies Group Ltd said on Thursday it has signed a contract with WMC Ltd to supply the plant control system for WMC's Olympic Dam expansion project.
Ci Technologies, whose shares listed on the Australian Stock Exchange on Thursday, said it would receive revenues under the contract in excess of A$13 million.
Completion of the contract was due to occur in 1998.
The expansion of Olympic Dam, a uranium, gold and silver operation, involved a significant expansion of WMC's Roxby Downs ore processing facility in South Australia.
Under the contract, Ci Technologies would provide the services of its systems engineers to WMC on a time cost basis.
The contract also involved the license by Ci Technologies on its CITECT software to WMC and the supply of hardware from nominated suppliers.
Ci Technologies shares at A$2.12 at 11.50 a.m. (0150 GMT), compared to their issue price of A$1.50.
